description: Fetches the current state of a conversion job by id: phase (queued/running/done/failed/cancelled), per-step progress, and the list of artifacts once done. Use this to check on a job after jj_convert_file or jj_convert_text stopped waiting for it.

id.description: Job id returned by jj_convert_file or jj_convert_text (e.g. "jb_9f2a1c7e4b6d8801").

name: jj_get_job
title: Get a conversion job status
